entries.title: Jeremiah 46:1
segments: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the nations;

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:2
segments: against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho, king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:3
segments: Set in order the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:4
segments: Harness the horses, and horsemen get up. Yea, stand with helmets, polish the spears; put on body armor.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:5
segments: Why have I seen? They are afraid, turned backward. And their mighty ones are beaten down and have fled [for] refuge, and they do not look back. Terror [is] all around, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:6
segments: Do not let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. They stumbled and fell toward the north, by the side of the river Euphrates.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:7
segments: Who [is] this rising up like the Nile, whose waters are moved like the rivers?

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:8
segments: Egypt rises up like the Nile, and [his] waters surge about like the rivers. And he says, I will go up [and] will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and its people.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:9
segments: Come up, horses; and rage chariots! And let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans who handle the shield, and the Lydians who handle [and] bend the bow.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:10
segments: For this [is] the day of the Lord Jehovah of hosts, a day of vengeance, that He may avenge Himself of His foes. And the sword shall devour, and it shall be filled and made drunk with their blood, for the Lord Jehovah of hosts has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:11
segments: Go up into Gilead and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt. In vain shall you use many medicines, [for] you shall not be cured.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:12
segments: The nations have heard of your shame, and your cry has filled the land. For the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, [and] they have both fallen together.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:13
segments: The word spoken by the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet, of the coming of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, to strike the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:14
segments: Declare [it] in Egypt, and cry [it] in Migdol, and make [it] heard in Noph and in Tahpanhes. Say, Stand fast and get ready, the sword shall devour all around you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:15
segments: Why is your mighty one swept away? They did not stand, because the LORD thrust him down.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:16
segments: He made many fall; yea, one fell on another. And they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people and to the land of our birth, away from the oppressing sword.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:17
segments: They cried there, Pharaoh king of Egypt [is] a noise; he has passed the chosen time.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:18
segments: [As] I live, says the King whose name [is] the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor [is] among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so he shall come.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:19
segments: O daughter dwelling in Egypt, get ready to go into captivity. For Noph shall be waste and a desert without inhabitant.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:20
segments: Egypt [is] a beautiful heifer, but a stinger from the north surely comes.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:21
segments: Also her hired ones [are] in her midst like calves of the stall; for they also have turned back, fleeing together. They did not stand, because the day of their calamity had come on them, the time of their visitation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:22
segments: Its sound [is] like a serpent's going, for they shall go in force and come against her with axes like woodcutters.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:23
segments: They shall cut down her forest, says the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the locusts and cannot be counted.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:24
segments: The daughter of Egypt shall be ashamed. She shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:25
segments: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods and their kings; even Pharaoh and all who trust in him;

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:26
segments: and I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. And afterward it will be inhabited, as in the days of old, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:27
segments: But you do not fear, O My servant Jacob, and be not afraid, O Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar off, and your seed from the land of their captivity. And Jacob shall return and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make [him]  afraid.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:28
segments: Do not fear, O Jacob My servant, says the LORD, for I [am] with you. For I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you. But I will not make a full end of you, but correct you in measure; yet I will not leave you wholly unpunished.
